evidence.text:
# EU net revenue data contract

Canonical asset: finance.fct_net_revenue_v2. Daily net revenue excludes VAT and subtracts refunds. Grain: business_date × country × currency. Amounts are in local currency. Convert to a common currency before aggregating across currencies. Coverage: EU. Owner: Finance Data. Completeness must be checked separately.

evidence.title: Net revenue metric definition
evidence.text:
# Net revenue metric definition

Net revenue = gross sales minus VAT minus refunds. finance.fct_net_revenue_v2 stores local currency values. Use approved daily FX rates for a combined EU total. Never sum EUR and PLN without conversion.

evidence.title: Revenue migration
evidence.text:
# Revenue migration

finance.daily_revenue is deprecated. EU consumers must migrate to finance.fct_net_revenue_v2. Legacy totals include VAT and omit late refunds. The two assets are not interchangeable.

evidence.title: Currency conversion policy

# Currency conversion policy

EU totals must use approved FX rates for the relevant business_date. Missing FX rates block aggregation. Currency conversion is required even when all country partitions are complete.
